}}'''Juan''' is a male NPC in {{location|Ragunna}}, found in the [[City Square]]. 

==Idle Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Juan:''' How do you reveal your feelings for someone in a way that's romantic yet sincere...
:'''Juan:''' Lady Rita still waits for my confession... Oh, the torment of love!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Juan:''' "You are the best thing that's ever happened to me."
:'''Juan:''' "You get my heart racing and give me butterflies."
:{{DIcon}} What?
:'''Juan:''' Oh, sorry! I was just practicing for a romantic confession.
:'''Juan:''' What do you think of those lines?
:{{DIcon}} Feels a bit stiff.
:'''Juan:''' Oh, my word. That's absolutely it! You must be someone who really knows their romantic talk. Please, give me some tips!
:{{DIcon}} Maybe try something more poetic?
:'''Juan:''' Poetic? Let's see...
:'''Juan:''' "I tried to pluck two stars from the sky for you, only to find they were nowhere near as bright as your eyes."
:{{DIcon}} Much better, but still too cliché.
:'''Juan:''' Cliché? So you're saying I should make my confession feel like it's tailor-made for my love?
:{{DIcon}} Yep. And don't forget that trick with the eyes.
:'''Juan:''' Copy that!
:'''Juan:''' "{{Rover}}, you always glide past me, yet seem more distant than the moon itself."
:'''Juan:''' "I yearn for tomorrow to bring you back, yet you remain unaware that my tomorrows fade into shadow without you."
:{{DIcon}} Not bad. It sounded like you meant it.
:'''Juan:''' "I wove webs to tighten the bond between our souls, only to end up ensnaring myself."
:'''Juan:''' "At this very moment, your fleeting words intensify my pain while granting me a brief, sweet happiness."
:{{DIcon}} Err. I think that's enough... You're doing great.
:'''Juan:''' "Go ahead and mock my recklessness, for I want to kiss your heart and leave my mark on your chest."
:'''Juan:''' "I want to breathe in the fragrance between your fingers, reaching right into your heart's desires."
----
;(Night, Septimont - Capitoline Hill City)
:'''Juan''': {{Rover}}, I didn't expect to see you here. Perhaps the moon has witnessed my prayers and sent you to me?
:{{DIcon}} What brings you here?
:'''Juan''': To seek love. I hope to find my true love within this glorious city...
:'''Juan''': I kissed the city's crimson walls to offer my most precious kiss, hoping she would accept my feelings...
:{{DIcon}} Have you found success?
:'''Juan''': No... but I've learned how to confess my feelings.
:'''Juan''': The city of glory taught me that passion is the key to confession. Hence, I share transform myself, just to let her know that...
:'''Juan''': I love you! I love you with every drop of passion within me!!!!!
:{{DIcon}} ???!
{{Dialogue End}}
